written.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 is 'the most pre-ordered' game of all time on both Xbox and PlayStation
written.description: What GamesRadar+, PC Gamer, Pure Xbox and Polygon reported: "Grand Theft Auto 6 is 'the most pre-ordered' game of all time on both Xbox and PlayStation".
written.body:
This page collects what named outlets published about Grand Theft Auto VI, in their own words. This site wrote none of the sentences in quotation marks below. Each one links to the report it was taken from.

## GamesRadar+, 9 November 2026

[GTA 6 launch files already hint at online multiplayer, PlayStation Store sleuth reports, leading to hopes we won't be waiting for a GTA Online follow-up for long](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/gta-6-launch-files-already-hint-at-online-multiplayer-playstation-store-sleuth-reports-leading-to-hopes-we-wont-be-waiting-for-a-gta-online-follow-up-for-long/)

The outlet's own summary:

> Could GTA 6 Online be arriving sooner than expected?

## GamesRadar+, 10 November 2026

[GTA 6 is officially the "most pre-ordered game" in PlayStation and Xbox store history, Sony and Microsoft confirm](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/gta-6-is-officially-the-most-pre-ordered-game-in-playstation-and-xbox-store-history-sony-and-microsoft-confirm/)

The outlet's own summary:

> Analysts report it's already beaten Cyberpunk 2077's pre-order record of 8 million copies

> Every Friday GamesRadar+ Your weekly update on everything you could ever want to know about the games you already love, games we know you're going to love in the near future, and tales from the communities that surround them.

## PC Gamer, 10 November 2026

[Grand Theft Auto 6 is 'the most pre-ordered' game of all time on both Xbox and PlayStation](https://www.pcgamer.com/games/grand-theft-auto/grand-theft-auto-6-is-the-most-pre-ordered-game-of-all-time-on-both-xbox-and-playstation/)

The outlet's own summary:

> On PC, however, GTA 6 remains among the least pre-ordered games of all time because, well, you know.

## GamesRadar+, 11 November 2026

[GTA 6 and Red Dead Redemption 2 artist: Sony and Microsoft can’t compete with Rockstar](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/quote-of-the-day-by-former-gta-6-and-red-dead-redemption-2-artist-sony-and-microsoft-cant-compete-with-rockstar-because-they-do-not-care-about-making-game-products/)

The outlet's own summary:

> And Rockstar's institutional knowledge is "absolutely priceless"

## Pure Xbox, 11 November 2026

[Xbox Brings Its Free Tier Of Cloud Gaming To Loads More Players Today](https://www.purexbox.com/news/2026/11/xbox-brings-its-free-tier-of-cloud-gaming-to-loads-more-players-today)

The outlet's own summary:

> Could prove popular for GTA 6?

> 0 8 Gabrie 9 mins ago @Balaam_ Anyone who doesn't have a console and doesn't want to or can't afford one.

> You buy the game you want to play, and “rent” the computing time needed to complete it on any device.

## Polygon, 13 November 2026

[Every Free Game You Can Keep on Steam, Epic, PlayStation Plus, and Xbox (Nov. 13-19)](https://www.polygon.com/free-games-right-now-steam-epic-ps-plus-nov-13-19/)

The outlet's own summary:

> Time to get gaming

> 19 Genre: Roguelike, turn-based How long to beat: N/A Developer: Mad Mango Games Whether you just want to unwind and play a few runs or want a game you can get completely sucked into, Knightica might just be what you're looking for.

> Entertainment/Sega If you prefer a more realistic and tactical approach to combat rather than fast-paced chaos, then perhaps you'll want to try Company of Heroes 3 instead.

> There's an array of factions and units to choose from, and it is up to you to decide how you want to approach each battle.

> Hypnospace Outlaw Image: No More Robots Hypnospace Outlaw is a 90s internet simulator where you play as a virtual enforcer.

## Pure Xbox, 13 November 2026

[PSA: Xbox And GTA 6 Have Both Pushed Out Small New Updates](https://www.purexbox.com/news/2026/11/psa-xbox-and-gta-6-have-both-pushed-out-small-new-updates)

The outlet's own summary:

> One's a console update, the other potentially a "day one" patch

> In any case, you'll want to get this queued up as soon as possible (unless you haven't installed the game yet, in which case it'll be included in your initial download).

> It’s required to start the game at launch. https://t.co/ejiJl0e3aG - GTA 6 Countdown ⏳ (@GTAVI_Countdown) November 13, 2026 Don't forget that Alpha Skip-Ahead Xbox Insiders have also received a special new update this week that adds three new features for testing purposes, so if you're part of the Insider programme, keep an eye out for that.

Every report above is on the site's fixed source list. A report is not a confirmation: the mark on each linked entry says who said it.
